description: Add a Finances (Expenses & Payouts) page with full CRUD for tracking expenses and payouts, monthly breakdown, and summary stats. Add navigation link in the sidebar.
steps: Create src/app/finances/page.tsx: A new page with metadata title 'Finances | CopyTrader'. Contains the FinancesPageContent component.

Create src/components/finances/finances-page.tsx: Main component with: (1) Summary cards at top showing Total Expenses, Total Payouts, Net Profit. (2) An 'Add Transaction' button that opens a dialog. (3) A table of transactions with columns: Date, Description, Amount, Type (expense/payout), Category. (4) Filters for type (all/expense/payout) and date range. (5) Monthly breakdown section showing a bar chart or table grouped by month.

Create src/components/finances/add-transaction-dialog.tsx: A dialog form with fields: date (input type date), description (text), amount (number), type (select: expense/payout), category (select: 'Platform Fee', 'Data Subscription', 'Funded Account Fee', 'Payout', 'Other'). On submit, adds to local state.

Add mock data for initial transactions: Mix of expenses (monthly funded account fees, platform subscriptions, data feeds) and payouts (funded account withdrawals). At least 10-15 entries spanning several months.

In src/components/shared/sidebar.tsx: Add a new nav item for '/finances' with label 'Finances' and an appropriate icon (e.g., Receipt or DollarSign from lucide-react). Place it between Metrics and Settings in the nav order.
Ensure the page supports editing and deleting existing transactions via row actions (dropdown with Edit/Delete).
acceptance_criteria: New /finances route is accessible and renders the finances page
Sidebar shows 'Finances' link between Metrics and Settings
Summary cards show total expenses, total payouts, and net profit
Users can add new transactions via dialog form
Table shows all transactions with proper formatting
findings: Build passes successfully. The /finances route is generated as a static page. All UI components (Dialog, Select, DropdownMenu, Badge) from shadcn/ui were available and used. The NODE_OPTIONS env var causes issues; use `unset NODE_OPTIONS` before running pnpm build.
